sections.name: Navbar
sections.description: Sticky marketing nav on a blurred page-tone veil: gradient-tile wordmark, journey-organised links, ghost sign-in plus one orange CTA, and a mobile menu that swaps in under 760px. Slim variant strips the nav to Pricing plus a single CTA for conversion pages; transparent variant sits over a hero.

usedBy.note: Sticky mega-menu with a single primary CTA
Mega-nav organized by buyer-journey stage and role, not product list
Nav grouped by lifecycle verbs: Channels / Build / Optimize / Scale
Persona/Roles menu as a first-class nav category
Persona switcher and theme toggle inside the marketing nav

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: The footer as sitemap: brand column with tagline and a one-field newsletter form, auto-fitting link columns, then a legal and social bar. Fat is the default grammar of the sweep; minimal collapses to one link row for lean pages; legal-only is the utility strip for sunset and legal pages.

usedBy.note: Massive footer as sitemap, enabling a radically short page
Fat footer carries the full IA the sparse page deliberately avoids
Free-tools column doubles as SEO and lead-gen surface
Competitor-comparison column plus compliance badges
Compare column plus a live status line

sections.name: Mega menu
sections.description: The navbar's expanded mega-menu panel, shown open as a specimen: header bar with the dual CTA pair, then a full-width panel of role-grouped link columns (uppercase eyebrows, one-line descriptions on the primary column only) and exactly one promo card in the trailing slot. Under 860px the panel stacks like the mobile drawer, promo last, CTA pair pinned at the end.

usedBy.note: Role-based Products columns (Revenue Marketing vs Sales Intelligence), Forrester Wave promo card, in-menu CTAs
Solutions menu with 3 audience columns plus promo cards; Resources menu as Get started / Learn / Discover / Get help
Products two-column layout with bundle and marketplace promos on the trailing edge; tabbed Solutions menu
Counter-example: simpler dropdowns plus a persistent Book a demo; role paths pushed to on-page cards instead

sections.name: Search overlay
sections.description: Command-K site search shown open as a specimen over a scrim: one input with an esc keycap, results grouped under section eyebrows with the matched fragment highlighted and a visible selection, then a one-line keycap legend footer. Empty state offers recent searches plus curated suggestions instead of a void; only worth shipping once the site has 30+ indexable pages.

usedBy.note: The reference anatomy: Ctrl/Cmd+K trigger, grouped results, recent searches, WAI-ARIA keyboard support
Counter-example verified: keyboard-first brand but no site search overlay; plain nav instead
